newsitem.title: WESTERN SAMOA: W.Samoan minister loses seat over bribery.
newsitem.headline: W.Samoan minister loses seat over bribery.

text.p: Western Samoa's Post and Telecommunications Minister Tolofua Ivalelei Leiataua Leauanae lost his seat on Tuesday after a charge of bribery in April's general election was upheld in the Supreme Court.
It was found that Tolofua bribed a voter for US$18, the equivalent of a week's pay in the small Pacific Island nation.
He is the fourth Human Rights Protection Party government member of parliament to be dumped following court rulings on charges of bribery and corruption.
In his summing up, Chief Justice Tiavaasue Falefatu Sapolu said the court found the evidence of wrongdoing overwhelming.
The government still holds 31 of the 49 seats in parliament.
